meta.title: Where Ontario’s rivers end
meta.method: Only river geometry inside Ontario is animated. Each connected visible network starts simultaneously at zero from its downstream shore or border crossing, with one common kilometres-per-second rate. Outside-region routes are retained only for the fact annotation, never the fill or its distance clock. Bars measure the mapped network length inside the region, including hidden lake connections. HydroRIVERS is generalized and omits many small streams and engineered diversions.
meta.systemColorMethod: Colors follow connected receiving-water tributary networks. Named nested branches receive their own color throughout their upstream subnetwork; stable outlet-derived shades distinguish smaller unnamed networks.
meta.farthestDefinition: In-Ontario connected river distance from the downstream receiving-water shore or provincial border crossing to the headwater. No distance outside the region is included.
meta.animationDistanceDefinition: Each contiguous in-Ontario drainage component starts at zero at its downstream receiving-water shore or provincial border crossing. One linear distance counter controls every component; no outside-region segment or distance participates in the fill.
meta.sourceDistanceCorrectionDefinition: sourceD0/sourceD1 preserve the inherited network model. clockD0/clockD1 add sourceDistanceCorrectionKm where an inherited receiving-mainstem zero omitted an in-province river approach; regional distances subtract only the corrected component origin.

policy.unmatchedMeans: No official name verified against this generalized map; not a claim that no name exists.

riverNameContinuity.method: Fill only existing parent-linked pieces between two verified anchors of the same official named feature. Stop at any different verified name, broken join, regional component boundary or terminal. No side-branch or one-sided extension.

source.namingPolicy: Name the drainage context only when every mapped basin outlet has the same verified downstream river name, or a verified name on its in-cell outlet mainstem. Otherwise show receiving-water context. No nearest-line or Voronoi basin inference.
